adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation looks up the booking by `id` and then always proceeds to `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`, `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`, and `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` without any checks on booking lifecycle (e.g., `booking.status`/cancellation) or timing (`startTime`/`endTime` vs now). The diff therefore supports the concern that this endpoint can mutate and send notifications for bookings that are already past or otherwise “inactive”, but the diff alone doesn’t prove this is forbidden behavior in the product, so it’s best treated as an edge-case/behavioral gap rather than a guaranteed defect.
